scripts.build: tsc -b && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && npm run build:internal && npm run build:external && npm run build:portals
scripts.build:portals: npm run build:vendor-onboarding && npm run build:proposal-tracker && npm run build:contract-monitoring
scripts.build:vendor-onboarding: vite build --mode vendor-onboarding && node scripts/finalize-portal.mjs vendor-onboarding
scripts.build:proposal-tracker: vite build --mode proposal-tracker && node scripts/finalize-portal.mjs proposal-tracker
scripts.build:contract-monitoring: vite build --mode contract-monitoring && node scripts/finalize-portal.mjs contract-monitoring
